Bulgarian

[edit]
Bulgarian Wikipedia has an article on:
бензин
Wikipedia bg

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French benzine.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [bɛnˈzin]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -in
  • Syllabification(key): бен‧зин

Noun

[edit]

бензи́н • (benzín) m

  1. (uncountable) petrol, gasoline, gas (motor fuel)
  2. (countable) a certain kind of gasoline

Declension

[edit]
Declension of бензи́н
singular plural
indefinite бензи́н

benzíni
definite
(subject form) 		бензи́нът
benzínǎt 		бензи́ните
benzínite
definite
(object form) 		бензи́на
benzína

benzína

Russian

бензин
Wikipedia ru

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from German Benzin.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [bʲɪn⁽ʲ⁾ˈzʲin]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (Saint Petersburg):(file)

Noun

[edit]

бензи́н • (benzín) m inan (genitive бензи́на, uncountable, relational adjective бензи́нный or бензи́новый)

  1. gasoline, petrol
    цена́ на бензи́н ― cená na benzín ― price of gasoline

Etymology

Borrowed from Russian бензин (benzin), itself cognate with English benzene.

[edit]

бензин • (benzin)

  1. petrol, gasoline
